name: io.github.tonyyang0504/instagram-mcp
description: Instagram (social): me, read_comments, reply_comment, read_mentions, analytics_post. Every tool maps

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_INSTAGRAM_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Instagram API with Facebook Login (host graph.facebook.com): a User or Page access token from Facebook Login for Business for a person with a role on the Facebook Page linked to the Instagram professional (Business or Creator) account, with instagram_basic, instagram_manage_comments, pages_read_engagement (and pages_show_list); sent as `Authorization: Bearer` (https://developers.facebook.com/docs/instagram-platform/comment-moderation).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_INSTAGRAM_IG_USER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Instagram professional account id (IG User id, e.g. 17841405822304914) - GET /{page_id}?fields=instagram_business_account returns it. me and read_mentions call /<ig_user_id>. Env: PLATFORM_MCP_INSTAGRAM_IG_USER_ID.
